points.description: First environmental problem stated precisely using the correct technical terms, matching one of the model answer's problems: leachate generation and its mismanagement (contamination of groundwater/surface water), OR release of greenhouse gases (GHGs, e.g. methane) due to anaerobic reactions/decomposition.
points.partial_credit: Half only if clearly more than half is precise, e.g. 'leachate' named with no mention of its generation/mismanagement or contamination, or 'GHG release' with no anaerobic cause. Vague wording earns 0.

points.description: Second, different environmental problem stated precisely, matching another item from the model answer: leachate generation and mismanagement; release of GHGs due to anaerobic reactions; odour; or insects and rodents infestation leading to public health issues. It must be distinct from P1.
points.partial_credit: Half only if clearly more than half is precise, e.g. 'pests' without rodents/insects or the public health link. Vague wording earns 0.

rubric.notes: Two distinct problems are needed, each worth 1 mark, and each must match an item in the model answer using the correct technical term (leachate, GHGs/methane from anaerobic reactions, odour, insects and rodents causing public health issues). Vague or generic statements such as 'pollution' or 'bad for environment' earn nothing. A wrong extra problem listed alongside the answers costs a point, and repeating the same problem in different words counts once.
